as_told.title: Maccabee briefs Clinton's science adviser at short notice

plain: In the 1990s, a CIA man named Ron Pandolfi is said to have arranged for Bruce Maccabee, a civilian UFO researcher, to brief the Clinton White House on UFOs. Michels tells it as Maccabee briefing Bill Clinton himself, with Pandolfi helping. The researcher Jason Simosa tells it from Maccabee's own account, calling him a Navy physicist: Pandolfi phoned and said, "I need you to go in and give the lecture you gave to the CIA once. I want you to give it to the science advisor." In Simosa's telling, then, the audience was Clinton's science adviser rather than the president. If true, it would mean UFO material reached the White House through a CIA back channel.
